from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

NAVY = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x3A, 0x5F)

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader")
    el.set(qn("w:val"), "true")
    trPr.append(el)

def add_runs(par, text, size=None, bold_all=False, italic=False, color=None):
    # supports **bold** markup
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        if not p:
            continue
        r = par.add_run(p)
        r.bold = bold_all or (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = color
    return par

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
    st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    for lvl, sz in ((1, 14), (2, 12), (3, 11)):
        h = d.styles["Heading %d" % lvl]
        h.font.name = "Calibri"
        h.font.size = Pt(sz)
        h.font.color.rgb = NAVY
        h.font.bold = True
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(10)
        h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(8.5), Inches(11)
    for m in ("left_margin", "right_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(0.8))
    sec.top_margin = Inches(0.8)
    sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.8)
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    add_runs(hp, "PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT — DRAFT", size=8, bold_all=True, color=NAVY)
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = fp.add_run("Greenleaf / Ridgepoint ROR Coverage Term Sheet — Page ")
    r.font.size = Pt(8)
    for code in ("begin", None, "end"):
        if code == "begin" or code == "end":
            fc = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); fc.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), code)
            rr = fp.add_run(); rr.font.size = Pt(8); rr._r.append(fc)
        else:
            it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = " PAGE "
            rr = fp.add_run(); rr.font.size = Pt(8); rr._r.append(it)
    return d

def para(d, text, size=None, italic=False, align=None, space_after=None, bold=False):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, italic=italic, bold_all=bold)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if space_after is not None:
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, numbered=False):
    style = "List Number" if numbered else ("List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style)
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def table(d, header, rows, widths, size=9, header_fill="1F3A5F", first_col_fill=None, fills=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    hdr = t.rows[0]
    set_repeat_header(hdr)
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = hdr.cells[i]
        c.width = Inches(widths[i])
        c.paragraphs[0].text = ""
        add_runs(c.paragraphs[0], h, size=size, bold_all=True, color=RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
        shade(c, header_fill)
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.width = Inches(widths[i])
            lines = val.split("\n") if isinstance(val, str) else [str(val)]
            c.paragraphs[0].text = ""
            for li, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if li == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                add_runs(p, line, size=size)
            if first_col_fill and i == 0:
                shade(c, first_col_fill)
            if fills and (ri, i) in fills:
                shade(c, fills[(ri, i)])
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv_table(d, title, pairs, widths=(1.6, 5.3), size=9, title_fill="1F3A5F", rating_fill=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.autofit = False
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    c = t.rows[0].cells[0].merge(t.rows[0].cells[1])
    c.paragraphs[0].text = ""
    add_runs(c.paragraphs[0], title, size=size + 1, bold_all=True, color=RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
    shade(c, title_fill)
    for k, v in pairs:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].width = Inches(widths[0]); cells[1].width = Inches(widths[1])
        cells[0].paragraphs[0].text = ""
        add_runs(cells[0].paragraphs[0], k, size=size, bold_all=True)
        shade(cells[0], "E8EEF5")
        lines = v.split("\n")
        cells[1].paragraphs[0].text = ""
        for li, line in enumerate(lines):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if li == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            add_runs(p, line, size=size)
        if rating_fill and k.startswith("Assessment"):
            shade(cells[1], rating_fill)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t
